$comment: Where `maronn-oidc generate` takes the generated code from. `pnpm run build` copies every source of `sources` into templates/<name>/ (tests excluded) and bakes the meta of the steps and endpoints of each hono-layout root into templates/<name>/<root>.catalog.json. A framework names its source, the root under it that becomes the output directory, its layout (hono: features/<id>/ and db/<kind>/; nextjs: the route groups (<id>)/, _oidc-provider/features/<id>/ and _oidc-provider/db/<kind>/), and files placed over that root (output path: source path under the source).
